description: This file manages temporary files, including creation, cleanup, signal handling, and lifecycle management within a software project.

classes.name: struct tempfile
classes.description: Represents a temporary file with lifecycle management, including file descriptor, filename, owner PID, and associated list node.

methods.name: remove_template_directory
methods.description: Removes the directory associated with a tempfile, handling signal context.

methods.name: remove_tempfiles
methods.description: Removes all active tempfiles owned by the current process, optionally handling signal context.

methods.name: remove_tempfiles_on_exit
methods.description: Cleanup handler registered at program exit to remove tempfiles.

methods.name: remove_tempfiles_on_signal
methods.description: Signal handler to cleanup tempfiles upon receiving a signal.

methods.name: new_tempfile
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new tempfile structure.

methods.name: activate_tempfile
methods.description: Adds a tempfile to the global list and sets its owner PID, initializing signal handlers if needed.

methods.name: deactivate_tempfile
methods.description: Removes a tempfile from the global list and frees associated resources.

methods.name: create_tempfile_mode
methods.description: Creates a new temporary file with specified mode and adds it to management.

methods.name: register_tempfile
methods.description: Registers an existing file path as a tempfile.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_sm
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with a filename template and mode.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_tsm
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in TMPDIR or /tmp with a filename template and mode.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_dt
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory and file within it based on a template.

methods.name: xmks_tempfile_m
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with error handling, dies on failure.

methods.name: fdopen_tempfile
methods.description: Associates a FILE pointer with the tempfile's file descriptor.

methods.name: get_tempfile_path
methods.description: Returns the filename of the tempfile.

methods.name: get_tempfile_fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the tempfile.

methods.name: get_tempfile_fp
methods.description: Returns the FILE pointer of the tempfile.

methods.name: close_tempfile_gently
methods.description: Closes the tempfile's file descriptor and FILE pointer, handling errors.

methods.name: reopen_tempfile
methods.description: Reopens a closed tempfile for writing.

methods.name: rename_tempfile
methods.description: Renames a tempfile to a new path, cleaning up old references.

methods.name: delete_tempfile
methods.description: Deletes and cleans up a tempfile, removing associated files and directory.
